panels.title: Reactor 1 — Synthesis (Glass-Lined Steel 5,000 L | Jacketed Heating & Cooling)
R1 Current Working Phase

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(e.name, 'Idle') AS "Phase Event Name", COALESCE(b.batch_id, 'No Active Batch') AS "Active Batch", COALESCE(to_char(NOW() - e.started_at, 'HH24:MI:SS'), '00:00:00') AS "Phase Duration" FROM assets a LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id, batch_id FROM batches WHERE current_asset_id = a.id AND status = 'Running' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) b ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT name, started_at FROM events WHERE asset_id = a.id AND batch_pk = b.id AND level = 'Phase' AND ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) e ON TRUE WHERE a.code = 'R1' LIMIT 1;

panels.title: R1 Thermal Reaction Profile & Jacket Mode

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.ts AS "time", r.value AS "value", t.name AS "metric" FROM readings r JOIN tags t ON r.tag_id = t.id JOIN assets a ON t.asset_id = a.id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts) AND a.code = 'R1' AND t.parameter IN ('TEMP', 'JKT_TEMP', 'JKT_MODE') ORDER BY r.ts ASC;

panels.title: ISA-88 Batch Tracking & Electronic Batch Record (EBR) Context
Batches in Train (R1 -> R2 -> R3 Material Flow)

targets.rawSql: SELECT b.batch_id AS "Batch ID", b.product_code AS "Product", b.recipe_version AS "Recipe", COALESCE(a.code, 'Discharged') AS "Current Reactor", b.status AS "Status", b.started_at AS "Started At", to_char(COALESCE(b.ended_at, NOW()) - b.started_at, 'HH24:MI:SS') AS "Elapsed Duration" FROM batches b LEFT JOIN assets a ON b.current_asset_id = a.id ORDER BY b.started_at DESC LIMIT 15;

panels.title: ISA-88 Events & Process Alarms Feed

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.started_at AS "Time", a.code AS "Reactor", COALESCE(b.batch_id, 'None') AS "Batch", e.level AS "Level", e.name AS "Event Name", CASE WHEN e.ended_at IS NULL THEN 'In Progress' ELSE 'Completed' END AS "State", to_char(COALESCE(e.ended_at, NOW()) - e.started_at, 'MI:SS') AS "Duration" FROM events e JOIN assets a ON e.asset_id = a.id LEFT JOIN batches b ON e.batch_pk = b.id ORDER BY e.started_at DESC LIMIT 25;

panels.title: Sensor Snapshots (1s Live Cache) & 1-Minute Rollups — Controlled by Table Filters
24-Tag Live Sensor Cache (Filtered by Table Filters)

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.code AS "Reactor", t.name AS "Tag", CASE WHEN t.is_cpp THEN '★ CPP' ELSE 'Standard' END AS "Type", CASE WHEN t.point_type = 'integer' THEN COALESCE(sl.label, s.value::text) ELSE ROUND(s.value::numeric, t.display_digits)::text END AS "Current Value", COALESCE(t.units, '') AS "Units", CASE s.quality WHEN 0 THEN 'Good' WHEN 1 THEN 'Questionable' WHEN 2 THEN 'Bad' WHEN 3 THEN 'Substituted' END AS "Quality", s.ts AS "Last Updated" FROM snapshots s JOIN tags t ON s.tag_id = t.id JOIN assets a ON t.asset_id = a.id LEFT JOIN tag_state_labels sl ON sl.tag_id = t.id AND sl.state_value = s.value::smallint WHERE a.code IN (${reactor:singlequote}) AND t.name IN (${tag:singlequote}) ORDER BY a.id, t.id;

panels.title: 1-Minute Rollup Audit & Data Verification (Filtered by Table Filters)

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.bucket AS "Time", a.code AS "Reactor", t.name AS "Tag", ROUND(r.avg_value::numeric, 2) AS "Avg Value", ROUND(r.min_value::numeric, 2) AS "Min Value", ROUND(r.max_value::numeric, 2) AS "Max Value", r.sample_count AS "Total Samples", r.good_count AS "Good Samples", ROUND((r.good_count::numeric / NULLIF(r.sample_count, 0) * 100), 1) AS "% Good" FROM readings_1min r JOIN tags t ON r.tag_id = t.id JOIN assets a ON t.asset_id = a.id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.bucket) AND a.code IN (${reactor:singlequote}) AND t.name IN (${tag:singlequote}) ORDER BY r.bucket DESC, a.code ASC, t.name ASC LIMIT 100;
